nina: quick sync on sirocco9b-int6 bring-up  — need a tiny econ+quality capsule for GTN. short please.

omar: TL;DR: ~22% token cost reduction vs int8 baseline; solid latency. quality dip on long-context extraction slices.

jia: perf: p50 98ms, p95 170ms on our v100 fleet (cold kv). warmed-kv expected to lift throughput ~15%. kv-hit ~31% currently.

omar: quick unit econ numbers (ballpark):
```
cost_per_token: $0.00065
avg_tokens_per_req: 210
unit_cost_per_req: ~$0.136
cost_delta_vs_int8: -22%
```

jia: quality: micro-eval against float32: MRR on QA parity; extraction recall down ~4% on multi-paragraph docs; short-chat metrics unchanged.

nina: product decision options: green/amber/red. one-line rec?

omar: amber: route chat & RAG; hold long-document extractors until priming/ensemble trials.

jia: ops note: schedule 4% canary to chat + run warmed-kv A/B (warm vs cold). collect decode traces for extract slices.

bench-bot: canary created: sirocco9b-int6 -> 2026-05-02T09:00Z, 4% chat traffic, warm-kv: both A/B, region: us-west-2. :white_check_mark:

nina: GTN blurb suggestion: "Sirocco9b-int6 cuts token costs ~22% with minimal latency impact; recommend gated rollout for chat/RAG and further mitigation work for long-document extraction before full rollout."

omar: I'll run a warmed-cache cost sweep tomorrow and post delta.

nina: perfect. small, actionable. we'll brief GTN with these bullets. :thumbsup:
